entries.name: Transfer Order Planning
entries.purpose: Turns a planned order into a real order in the module it belongs to: production, purchase, warehouse, or cost-peg transfer.
entries.route: Planning ➔ Plan Transfer ➔ Transfer Order Planning

entries.name: Planning Parameters

entries.name: Scenarios

entries.name: Sourcing Strategy

entries.name: Generate Pegging Relations

entries.name: Item Order Plan
entries.purpose: Shows one item's order plan over time: demand and forecast against scheduled receipts and planned supply.
entries.route: Planning ➔ Order Planning ➔ Item Order Plan

entries.name: Item Order Plan - Find

entries.name: Order Pegging

entries.name: Planned Orders
entries.purpose: Lists the planned orders MRP created, to review and select before they're transferred to real orders.
entries.route: Planning ➔ Order Planning ➔ Planned Orders

entries.name: Confirm Order Planning
entries.purpose: Confirms a range of planned orders in one run, and can take only those inside their order lead time.
entries.route: Planning ➔ Order Planning ➔ Confirm Order Planning

entries.name: Generate Order Planning

entries.name: Planned Order
entries.purpose: Shows one planned order in detail: its order lines, which you can change here, and the demand each line was created for.
entries.route: double-click a planned order in Planned Orders (cprrp1100m000)

entries.name: Implemented Software Components

entries.name: Buy-from Business Partner

entries.name: Business Partners

entries.name: Buy-from Business Partners

entries.name: Item - Ordering Defaults

entries.name: Item - Ordering by Site

entries.purpose: Lists the segments a mask is built from.
entries.route: Master Data ➔ Items ➔ Miscellaneous ➔ Masks ➔ Mask Segments

entries.name: Product Types

entries.name: Product Groups

entries.name: Harmonized System Codes

entries.route: Master Data ➔ Items ➔ Item Classification ➔ Harmonized System Codes

entries.name: Statistical Groups

entries.route: Master Data ➔ Code Definitions ➔ Logistic Codes ➔ Statistical Groups

entries.name: Product Classes

entries.route: Master Data ➔ Items ➔ Item Classification ➔ Product Classes

entries.purpose: Lists the language models the Infor GenAI service offers LN, and which one is the default.
entries.route: Tools ➔ Application Extensibility ➔ Embedded GenAI ➔ GenAI LLMs

entries.name: GenAI LLM Versions
entries.purpose: Lists the versions of one language model, and which version the Infor GenAI service uses by default.
entries.route: from GenAI LLMs (ttrpi5560m000), Actions menu

entries.name: Inventory Handling Parameters
entries.purpose: Holds the picking and shipping parameters for the whole company, as dated sets with one current set.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Parameters ➔ Inventory Handling Parameters

entries.name: Activities by Procedure
entries.purpose: Sets which activities a warehousing procedure has, and which of them run automatically.
entries.route: unstated in the help; the parent Procedures (whinh0105m000) is on the menu

entries.name: Warehousing Order Types
entries.purpose: Holds the settings a warehousing order type gives its orders, among them its inventory transaction type and how its shipments and loads are built.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Master Data ➔ Order Procedures ➔ Order Types

entries.name: Default Order Types by Origin
entries.purpose: Links a warehousing order type to an order origin, so orders from that origin get that type and its procedure by default.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Master Data ➔ Order Procedures ➔ Default Order Types by Origin

entries.name: Warehousing Orders
entries.purpose: Lists warehousing orders, where almost every warehousing procedure starts.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Orders ➔ Orders

entries.name: Warehousing Order
entries.purpose: Shows one warehousing order, which starts and controls one inventory movement. LN creates it, or you enter it by hand.
entries.route: drill into an order row on Warehouse Manager Dashboard (whinh2300m000), or on Orders (whinh2100m000)

entries.name: Activities by Warehousing Order
entries.purpose: Sets which warehousing procedure activities apply to one order. This is the only place to change them for a single order.
entries.route: the appropriate menu of Warehousing Orders (whinh2100m000)

entries.name: Outbound Order Lines
entries.purpose: Releases outbound advice for single order lines.
entries.route: the Outbound Lines tab of Warehousing Order (whinh2100m100)

entries.name: Outbound Line Status Overview
entries.purpose: Shows, for one outbound order line, which procedure activities will run and how the quantity moves through them.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Orders ➔ Outbound Line Status Overview

entries.name: Warehouse Manager Dashboard
entries.purpose: Shows overviews of inbound and outbound warehousing orders.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Manager Dashboard

entries.name: Warehouse Inspections Overview
entries.purpose: Shows and changes inbound and outbound inspections, the step that can hold a receipt.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Receipts/Inspections ➔ Inspections Overview

entries.name: Generate Inbound Advice
entries.purpose: Generates inbound advice for received goods. It isn't available in a warehouse without locations.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Inbound ➔ Generate Inbound Advice

entries.name: Warehouse Receipt
entries.purpose: Creates and confirms receipts, where incoming goods become inventory.
entries.route: Actions - Receive from the inbound order line, or drill in from the receipt list

entries.name: Receipt Message Log
entries.purpose: Keeps the error and information messages raised on a receipt line, so you can still read them after closing the dialog.
entries.route: the Message Log tab in the lines pane of Warehouse Receipt (whinh3512m000), or opened from it

entries.name: Shipments
entries.purpose: Shows, changes and confirms shipments.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Shipments ➔ Shipments

entries.name: Shipment Lines
entries.purpose: Changes a shipped quantity. This is the only place to do it, and only before the shipment line is confirmed.
entries.route: drill-in from Shipments (whinh4130m000)

entries.name: Delivery Notes
entries.purpose: Lists the delivery notes LN makes for shipments: the paper that travels with the goods.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Shipments ➔ Documents ➔ Delivery Notes

entries.name: Process Pro Forma Invoices
entries.purpose: Creates pro forma invoices for frozen or confirmed shipments, to review before invoicing.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Shipments ➔ Documents ➔ Process Pro Forma Invoices

entries.name: Process Invoices
entries.purpose: Creates the final invoice for confirmed shipments.
entries.route: unstated in the help; its pro forma twin whinh4279m000 is on the menu under Shipments - Documents

entries.name: Picking List
entries.purpose: Confirms an advised quantity as picked, where picking is an activity in the warehousing procedure.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Outbound/Inspections ➔ Picking List

entries.name: Shipment
entries.purpose: Shows and changes shipments. Here a shipment is frozen and confirmed, and the inventory leaves.
entries.route: drill into a row on Shipments (whinh4130m000)

entries.name: Approve Adjustment Order Variances
entries.purpose: Approves adjustment order lines that need approval. This is the second stage, not the booking.
entries.route: unstated in the help; the Cycle Counting/Adjustment Orders node is on the menu

entries.name: Shipment Workbench
entries.purpose: Lists the shipments waiting at a warehouse's staging area or docks, to freeze, confirm or reopen them from one place.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Shipments ➔ Shipment Workbench

entries.name: Shipment Execution Workbench
entries.purpose: Runs a shipment's outbound steps from one screen, from generating advice to confirming.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Shipments ➔ Shipment Execution Workbench

entries.name: Shipment Planning Workbench
entries.purpose: Plans a week of shipments by turning outbound order lines into projected shipments before anything is picked.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Shipments ➔ Shipment Planning Workbench

entries.name: Planned Inventory Transactions - Graphical View
entries.purpose: Shows one item's planned receipts and issues as a graph, with tiles for what's on hand, overdue, and due in or out today.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Inventory Planning & Analysis ➔ Planning ➔ Planned Inventory Transactions - Graphical View

entries.name: Item, Lot and Serial 360
entries.purpose: Shows the transactions of one item, lot or serial number, and what a lot or serialized item was built from.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Item, Lot and Serial 360

entries.name: Warehouses
entries.purpose: Lists the warehouses defined for the current logistics company.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Master Data ➔ Warehouses ➔ Warehouses

entries.name: Warehouse - Item Inventory
entries.purpose: Lists one row for each warehouse that holds or expects an item, where you choose a warehouse to ship from.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Inventory Reporting ➔ Inventory Position ➔ Warehouse - Item Inventory

entries.name: Company - Item Inventory
entries.purpose: Lists every item with its inventory across the company: on hand, blocked, on order and allocated.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Inventory Reporting ➔ Inventory Position ➔ Company - Item Inventory

entries.name: Item - Warehousing Defaults
entries.purpose: Holds the default warehousing data for an item type and item group combination: lot, serial, ownership and cross-docking.
entries.route: the blue [Warehousing] link on Item Defaults (tcibd0502m000)

entries.name: Inventory 360
entries.purpose: Shows where an item's stock is and what state it's in. It's the place to start any question about stock.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Inventory 360

entries.name: Inventory 360 - Graphical View
entries.purpose: Shows Inventory 360 with a graph and four tiles that count the items heading for trouble and filter the list to them.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Inventory 360 - Graphical View

entries.name: Item - Warehousing
entries.purpose: Holds the warehousing details of one item: location control, inventory differences and supply settings.
entries.route: drill-in from Item (tcibd0501m100); it opens as a dialog over that session

entries.name: Stock Point Blocking
entries.purpose: Blocks one stock point, fully or for a quantity, so the stock is held and not issued.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Blocking ➔ Inventory Blocking ➔ by Stock Point
